description: This file declares functions related to tensor operations in the torch::inductor namespace, including matrix multiplication, tensor allocation, and tensor reinterpretation.

methods.name: _mm_plus_mm_out
methods.description: Performs a matrix multiplication plus addition with output stored in 'out'.

methods.name: _mm_plus_mm
methods.description: Performs a matrix multiplication plus addition, returning the result. Deprecated in favor of the out variant.

methods.name: _alloc_from_pool
methods.description: Allocates a tensor from a memory pool with specific offset, dtype, size, and stride.

methods.name: _reinterpret_tensor
methods.description: Creates a new tensor view with modified size, stride, and offset, similar to as_strided but with added offset and disabled view tracking.
